title: The Truth of the Destiny Twins
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'Our confrontation might rewrite the eternal chess game.'

text.content: The Universe's Eye's laughter still echoed, and Chen Ji felt like an unfolded chess manual, every pattern scrutinized by that transcendent gaze. He stood in the Void, surrounded by endless remnants of star rivers—the graveyards of civilizations devoured by the Ultimate Chess Player. Ling Yuan's phantom flickered behind him, the old Sect Master's eyes shimmering with complex emotions, anticipation mingled with fear. 'Interesting, the first piece in ten thousand years to dare resist.' The voice rang out again. Chen Ji clenched his teeth, his Heavenly Fate burning fiercely within, yet finding no exit in this rule-distorted Void.

dialogue.content: You think arriving here changes anything? The Heaven's Dao Eye's voice rang like a great bell, each word shaking Chen Ji's soul. 'The Tianji Record is merely a sieve I spread across the world to filter the most suitable vessel for bearing this karma. You... are perfect.'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to retort, an intense fluctuation erupted from the depths of his Mental Sea. It was the Tianji Record Fragment's resonance—not from within, but from some existence approaching at the same frequency. He abruptly turned, only to see in the distant star river remnants, a black-purple light tearing through the Void. The aura within that light made his heart seize—it was something blood-connected yet diametrically opposed.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently, the old Sect Master's phantom becoming ferocious and distorted: 'He's coming... The Demonic Path Commander... You cannot let him approach!' Chen Ji swept Ling Yuan a cold glance—the old fox of Tianqing Sect此刻眼中所流露的恐惧比被他算计时更甚百倍。

text.content: The black-purple light drew ever closer, and Chen Ji finally saw the approaching figure. It was a man of similar age, clad in battle armor embroidered with demonic patterns, his features bearing seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji yet appearing colder and more ruthless. A dark crimson mark graced his brow center, its patterns matching the Tianji Record's markings in Chen Ji's Mental Sea perfectly. His pupils were deep gold—a sign of fate power's deep corrosion.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander strode across the void, each step causing tremors in the surrounding star river remnants. He stopped ten zhang from Chen Ji, a complex smile curving his lips: 'Chen Ji... or should I say, my other half?' His voice was deep and resonant, yet carried a strange sense of familiarity, as if Chen Ji were speaking to himself.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He raised his left hand, his sleeve falling away to reveal the faintly visible fate patterns on his inner arm. Simultaneously, on the Demonic Path Commander's right arm, a perfectly symmetrical pattern was glowing. The two sets of patterns responded to each other across the distance, weaving together in the Void to form a complete design—a Yin-Yang Taiji symbol, with each fish representing one of them.

Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice cold as millennium-old ice: 'Who are you?' The Demonic Path Commander threw his head back in laughter, yet the sound carried an undeniable bitterness: 'Who am I? I am the failed product of the Ultimate Chess Player from ten thousand years ago. You are his masterpiece. We are both his designed Destiny Twins—one bearing Heavenly Secrets, the other bearing Calamitous Fortune.'

dialogue.content: The Heaven's Dao Eye's voice sounded again, this time with a touch of playfulness: 'Correct. Ten thousand years ago, I split the Tianji Record in two, granting half to the righteous path and implanting half in the Demonic Path. You were meant to meet at the final moment, merge into one, and become the vessel of the new Heavenly Dao will. Unfortunately...' The voice drawled, 'Neither of you obeyed.'

choice.prompt: Facing the truth of the Destiny Twins, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Cooperate with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: Since we are both pieces, why not join hands to break the chessboard? The Demonic Path Commander's Combat Power combined with Chen Ji's scheming might tear through the Ultimate Chess Player's封锁.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete power of the Destiny Twins
choices.risk_hint: The Heaven's Dao Eye will never watch your alliance idly
choices.process_label: 陈机选择了一条从未有人走过的路

text.content: Chen Ji slowly extended his hand, that fate-patterned palm meeting the Demonic Path Commander's in mid-air. In an instant, heaven and earth lost their colors as two fate lines, intertwined for ten thousand years, finally converged. Chen Ji felt a surge of boundless power flood his body—the power of 'Calamitous Fortune,' merging perfectly with his 'Heavenly Secrets,' complementing each other's weaknesses.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's remnant soul let out a shrill scream: 'No! Your fusion will destroy everything!' Chen Ji coldly gazed at him: 'What you're destroying is your own ambition, old Sect Master. You were abandoned by the Tianji Record ten thousand years ago, and now you want to drag both of us down?'

choices.text: Confront the Demonic Path Commander on the spot
choices.description: Regardless of this Destiny Twin nonsense, since we're on opposite sides, there's only victory or defeat. Chen Ji never believed in the phrase 'destined by fate.'
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Prove the will of 'my fate is determined by myself'
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's Combat Power is not inferior to Chen Ji's

text.content: Without any premonition, Chen Ji launched himself forward, the power of the Tianji Record condensing into blades at his fingertips. His speed even slightly startled the Demonic Path Commander—truly, this 'waste's' genuine Combat Power far exceeded estimates. However, the Demonic Path Commander merely raised his hand lightly, dispersing the thunderous strike.

dialogue.content: 'What's the rush?' The Demonic Path Commander remained unmoved, yet a glimmer of appreciation flashed in his eyes. 'We're both discarded pieces—why destroy each other?' Chen Ji coldly laughed: 'Save your rhetoric. When your Demonic Path armies slaughtered all living things, did you spare a thought for this?'

choices.description: What right do you have to decide our fate? Chen Ji decided to direct his spear at the true mastermind first.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heaven's Dao Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the truth of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chess Player's fury is unbearable for mortals

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly turned, facing the Heaven's Dao Eye in the depths of the Void. His voice rang clear and resolute: 'You call us pieces—then who is the chess player? You keep speaking of ten thousand years ago—could it be that you yourself are merely another existence on a larger chessboard?' This speech caused the entire Universe's Eye to fall silent for a moment.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander slightly startled, then burst into laughter: 'Bold! The first mortal in ten thousand years to dare question heaven's way.' The Heaven's Dao Eye remained silent for a long time—so long that Chen Ji thought it would never respond. Finally, that voice sounded again, carrying a trace of... appreciation? 'Interesting.'

text.content: The Heaven's Dao Eye's light twisted in the Void, as if re-evaluating this ant before it. After a moment, its voice sounded again, this time with less playfulness and more... seriousness? 'You wish to know the truth? Very well, I shall show you something.' A massive scene suddenly unfurled in the Void—the images of ten thousand years past.

In the scene, a man identical to Chen Ji stood upon the Heavenly Dao Altar, surrounded by countless weeping departed souls. The man's eyes held both compassion and resolve. He tore the Tianji Record in his hands into two halves—one cast toward the righteous path, the other sinking into the Demon Abyss. 'This is the true origin of the Tianji Record—it is the chain sealing the calamity fortune of ten thousand souls.' The Heaven's Dao Eye's voice was ice-cold. 'And you are the key to that chain.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's remnant soul suddenly emitted a sharp laugh: 'So that's it! So this is what the old Sect Master had me seeking!' He madly lunged toward the Heaven's Dao Eye. 'Let me fuse them! Let me become the new heaven!' Chen Ji coldly raised his hand, the power of the Tianji Record forming a barrier that trapped Ling Yuan within.

'Old Sect Master, why the rush?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'When you told me in the Scripture Pavilion that Tianqing Sect's future rested on me, this is what you meant—you wanted to use my body to fuse the two fates, becoming heaven's new puppet.' A mocking smile curved his lips. 'Unfortunately, you don't even qualify as a piece.'

text.content: Trapped within the barrier, Ling Yuan's features were contorted beyond recognition. Meanwhile, the Demonic Path Commander watched it all in silence, his expression growing ever more complex. Finally, he spoke: 'Chen Ji, I thought you were merely a calculating mortal. Unexpectedly... you're even crazier than me.' His tone carried a hint of mutual respect.

choice.prompt: The situation gradually clarified, and the relationship between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander becomes key:

choices.text: Form an alliance with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Since both the Heaven's Dao Eye and Ling Yuan wish to use them, they might as well join forces to counterattack.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the infamy of 'colluding with the Demonic Path'
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's strategic-level assistance
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's true intentions remain unclear
choices.process_label: 陈机向魔道主帅伸出手

text.content: Chen Ji slowly spoke: 'The person ten thousand years ago tore the Tianji Record apart to prevent anyone from gathering both fates. We're both incomplete pieces.' He looked at the Demonic Path Commander. 'But what if two incompletions joined hands?' The Demonic Path Commander fell silent for a moment, then smiled: 'Are you inviting me?'

choices.description: Chen Ji never believed anyone would help him without cost. He chose to face the Heaven's Dao Eye alone.
choices.risk_hint: Opposing both heaven and Ling Yuan alone carries enormous risk
choices.process_label: 陈机拒绝了魔道主帅的暗示

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head: 'I don't need allies.' His tone was detached yet resolute. 'For ten thousand years, countless people have tried to use me—from Ling Yuan to the Heaven's Dao Eye—none succeeded. I reached today through my own strength.' The Demonic Path Commander raised an eyebrow: 'Interesting. Then I'll see how far you can go without allies.'

Just then, a violent tremor suddenly erupted in the Void. Ling Yuan's remnant soul had somehow broken free of Chen Ji's barrier, his form swelling madly as he absorbed the residual fate power in this space. 'Ha ha ha!' Ling Yuan's laughter was manic and triumphant. 'You think I spent all these years lurking in Tianqing Sect for nothing?' His eyes had turned pure gold—the color of gods. 'Because I made a deal with the Heaven's Dao Eye long ago!'

dialogue.content: The Heaven's Dao Eye's voice sounded, carrying a hint of impatience: 'Annoying.' A purple thunderbolt materialized from nothingness, striking directly toward Ling Yuan. However, the current Ling Yuan was no longer entirely mortal. He reached out and caught the thunder, grinning wickedly: 'Heavenly Lord, did you forget? I am your personally selected... backup piece!'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He watched this absurd spectacle before him—the Heaven's Dao Eye, Ling Yuan, the Demonic Path Commander... everyone scheming, everyone contending. And he and the Demonic Path Commander were merely two pieces being manipulated in this ten-thousand-year chess game. 'Enough.' Chen Ji's voice rang out calmly, yet caused everyone to fall silent for a moment. 'You all want what's on me? Come and take it.'

dialogue.content: The Heaven's Dao Eye fell silent for a moment, then let out a profound laugh: 'Interesting. For ten thousand years, finally two pieces have emerged that make me take seriously.' Its voice turned solemn. 'Since you both possess such spirit, I shall give you one chance—three days from now, at the Heavenly Dao Altar, I shall personally play a game with you. Win, and you rewrite fate; lose...' The voice drawled, 'and you become the new nourishment for heaven.'

text.content: The words fell, and the Universe's Eye began to dissolve. Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander were simultaneously expelled from this Void by a powerful force. When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself back at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Su Qingyao anxiously waited nearby, and upon seeing him awaken, obvious relief flickered in her eyes. 'You...' She hesitated, finally only saying, 'The life jade of Elder Ling Yuan... just shattered.' Chen Ji said nothing, merely raising his gaze toward the horizon. Three days, only three days. And in his mind, that voice intertwined with his fate sounded once more—'Our confrontation might rewrite the eternal chess game.'
